intro.label: THE VINE BAPTIST CHURCH
intro.title: Jesus said, "I am the vine." (John 15:5)
intro.imageAlt: Vine Baptist Church main campus building
intro.affiliation: The Vine Baptist Church is affiliated with the Korea Baptist Convention (KBC).
intro.p1: At Vine Baptist Church, we believe that lasting spiritual fruit comes only through abiding in Christ. As we remain in Him, He lives and works through us, accomplishing His purposes for His Church and His Kingdom.
intro.p2: This biblical truth is the inspiration behind the name Vine Baptist Church and shapes everything we do.

intro.purpose: At Vine Baptist Church, we uphold the Bible as the final authority for our faith and practice. We are committed to knowing God, living in intimate fellowship with Him, and participating wholeheartedly in His work through worship, prayer, discipleship, missions, service, and fellowship.
vision: We believe that God is calling His Church to participate in His work in this generation. Our vision is to see the Church restored to God's original design and to prepare the way for His revival.

To pursue this vision, we are firmly rooted in the Gospel of the Cross and the ministry of the Holy Spirit. We believe that Jesus Christ alone is the foundation of the Church (1 Corinthians 3:11). Upon this foundation, we seek to faithfully follow Him while welcoming the transforming work of the Holy Spirit in our lives and ministry.

ministries.title: The Piece
ministries.subtitle:
Where is your piece in this great work of God?
Christ’s lordship and life to every nation, every generation, and every sphere!
ministries.pieceAlt: The Piece — the five connected ministries of Vine Baptist Church

items.title: New Wave Ministries
items.desc: New Wave Mission is a voluntary network of churches united by the vision of seeing the Church restored to God's original design and preparing the way for His revival. Together, we work to advance God's Kingdom while recognizing the many networks God is raising up around the world.

items.title: Y Mission
items.desc: Y Mission is a movement that connects local churches, military ministry, and campus ministry, extending these partnerships into workplace ministry and global missions. Our vision is to see the younger generation of Korea return to God and be sent to the nations to fulfill His mission.

items.title: Africa Project
items.desc: Africa Project is a non-governmental organization (NGO) dedicated to supporting the development of communities across Africa through humanitarian initiatives. Our vision is to see Africa become a land of healing and hope by connecting people, organizations, and expertise to create lasting impact.

items.title: School
items.desc: New Wave Christian School is dedicated to nurturing the next generation to grow in the essence of the Christian faith. We develop creative and integrative leaders with a balanced foundation of spiritual maturity, godly character, and intellectual excellence.

dailyRows.service: Isaiah 62 Prayer with the Worship Team

oikos.title: Oikos Ministry
oikos.desc: Oikos is the name of the small groups at Vine Baptist Church. As one of our church's core values, every member belongs to an Oikos and is encouraged to participate actively in its life and ministry.
